title: KAITO — Wonderland SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, we're getting there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Greetings, KAITO.
I hope I'm not interrupting anything?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello, Rui.
You came here on your own this time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Is that surprising?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, it seems to be the new trend...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nevermind.
You're always welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm in the middle of tidying up the stage.
I'm sorry I can't give you my full attention at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you like me to help?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you don't mind?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be happy to lend you a hand, if we could chat a little about this SEKAI while we're at it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This world is one big mystery, and I'm very curious about it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure, we can talk while getting this place in order.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First, we need to roll call the puppets and plushies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Roll call?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This is to check that one's gone missing.
You do it like this... Puppets, line up!

rows.Speaker: Puppets
rows.Line: Here♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it's certainly helpful when your props can line up when called to account for everything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It makes it much easier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Could you call out numbers and check if we've got everyone? I'll count the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure, you can leave this to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Plushies, line up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, we got everyone.
Thank you for your hard work, plushies and puppets! See you at the next show!

rows.Speaker: Puppets
rows.Line: Okay♪ See you next time♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So you just let them go?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. They can roam freely in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have quite the variety of plushies and puppets. Some are cute, some have a cool look. They also come in all colors and sizes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What criteria do you use to choose the right ones for your shows?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't. I enroll the ones who volunteer to help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As you know, this world is created from strong feelings. They shaped each of the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean Tsukasa's feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes. And it's not only the plushies.
Everything here reflects something in Tsukasa's psyche.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's probably why instead of a human audience, we have toys and animals watching our shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think that it's because when Tsukasa was little, he used to play theater in front of his toys.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's so, then do you suppose the wild variety of genres of your shows is also to do with Tsukasa's experiences?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I would think so.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why don't you ask Tsukasa about it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Getting to know him better is the key to understanding this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... We're not really the sort of close friends who'd discuss each other's childhood memories.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's always fixated on the latest show we're working on and that's all we talk about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On the other hand, he's the only person who can offer the most valuable insight into this world... So I might try to have a more personal chat with him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You definitely should.
It makes me happy that you have an interest in our SEKAI.
